name: MagnaGarurumon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may return 1 card with the [Hybrid] trait from this Digimon's digivolution cards to your hand to return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the same level as the returned card to its owner's hand.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an effect adds a card to your hand, you may unsuspend 1 of your Digimon.
